changelog_en: ⭐ What's New: - Added automatic multi-account rotation (Supercell ID) - Prepared Smart Spell Deployment feature (Under development) - Optimized screen scanning performance 🐞 Bug Fixes: - Fixed AI model loading issues in compiled EXE - Fixed account template path mismatch in compiled EXE ⚠️ NOTICE FOR v2.4.5 USERS: After the download reaches 100% and halts, please CLOSE the bot, then manually extract the file update_temp.zip (which has been automatically downloaded to your bot folder) to upgrade to 2.5.0.
